tasks.short: Provide users with technical support for computer problems.

steps.what: Provide users with technical support for computer problems
Pull the related ticket and change history

outputs: filed copy of signed support resolution v1

tasks.design: The ticket log in {HELPDESK} shows the history. The manager provides the technical support, signs the resolution, and a job files that version. A job does not close the problem or reply to the user.
tasks.previous_blocker: History was searched by hand while the user waited, and the resolution was not always filed.
tasks.enabler_now: Ticket and change history can be listed from the existing log.
tasks.still_hard: The cause of a new problem is not in the history.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the fix and what to tell the user.
tasks.altitude: The support conversation stays. Searching history and filing the signed resolution shrink.

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.

assumptions: The job does not reply to the user.
unknowns: Which problems the manager still takes personally.
Whether a resolution may include an access change.
research_questions: How often the history is missing for the system in question.

already_counted.description: Providing support stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop security, control, and disaster recovery for information resources.

steps.what: Develop computer information resources for security and control
List existing backup jobs and control points
Set disaster recovery and strategic computing needs
Sign the security and recovery plan

outputs: filed copy of signed recovery plan v1

tasks.design: A configured view lists backup jobs that already exist on {DATA_PLATFORM}. Their runtime is not treated as new labour saved. The manager develops the security and control plan, sets disaster recovery needs, signs the plan in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. A job does not change access.
tasks.previous_blocker: The control story was a document that had drifted from the jobs that actually run.
tasks.enabler_now: The job catalogue can be listed without building a new backup.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what must be recoverable is still a management judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sets the control and the recovery need.

ambition.what: Refresh the control inventory when a backup job is added, before the plan is signed again.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the plan on what must be protected, not on hunting the catalogue.

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
Digest [S14] requires works-council consent for hiring, appraisal, staff data, or monitoring unless a collective agreement settles it, so this design does not add a watch or a score.

assumptions: Listing jobs is not a claim that their runtime was human work.
No job changes an access right.
unknowns: Which systems are in the recovery scope.
Who else must sign the plan.
research_questions: Whether the catalogue includes every store that holds personal data.

already_counted.description: Developing the plan stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit, hire, train, supervise, and take staffing decisions.

steps.what: Recruit, hire, train, and supervise staff
Participate in staffing decisions with the panel

outputs: filed copy of signed staffing decision v1

tasks.design: Recruiting, hiring, training, and supervision stay with the manager and the panel. The manager signs the staffing decision in {HCM}, and a job files that version. No model scores a candidate or makes the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decision was easy to leave as a verbal panel outcome.
tasks.enabler_now: The personnel record can store a signed decision.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a person cannot be reduced to a form.
tasks.human_edge: The manager makes the staffing decision and remains responsible for it.
tasks.altitude: Hiring and supervision do not shrink. Filing the signed decision does.

reach.task: Record only the decision the manager signed
reach.learn: That a model does not score the candidate

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] bars a significant decision about a person made solely by automation, so assignment and hiring stay with the manager.
Digest [S20] says employers keep their duties where a screening tool is challenged, so the hire decision stays with the manager.
Digest [S14] requires works-council consent for hiring, appraisal, staff data, or monitoring unless a collective agreement settles it, so this design does not add a watch or a score.

assumptions: Configure the personnel record before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether the works council must consent before any hiring aid.
research_questions: Which staffing choices are hires and which are internal moves.

already_counted.description: Recruiting and the panel stay inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stay abreast of advances in technology.

steps.what: List titles on advances in technology
Read advances in technology and keep the source
Note what will keep the manager abreast

outputs: filed copy of signed technology note v1

tasks.design: A desk lists titles and citations in {DOCS}. The manager reads the advances, decides what will keep them abreast, signs a short note, and a job files it. The list is not a summary, and it does not change a system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful advances were easy to miss, and the note of what to try was not filed.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained source list can be listed without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Judging an advance still means reading it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what is worth a trial here.
tasks.altitude: Reading does not shrink. Listing titles and filing the note do.

reach.task: Trial only what the signed note names

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
The management digest says a records path can draft a report that cites record ids, and a person signs.

assumptions: The desk does not claim a source is correct.
unknowns: Which sources the firm already pays for.
Whether the note may name a vendor trial.
research_questions: How often the useful advance is not on the source list.

already_counted.description: Reading stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only assembly and filing move to a job. The meeting, the decision, and the signature stay with the manager, after a small upkeep allowance.

role.altitude: The information systems manager spends the week on priorities, people, and the signed decision. Ticket totals and filing a signed note move to a job. A backup that already runs is not saved labour.
reach: Service desk leads receive a signed priority list instead of a verbal shuffle.
Analysts see the assignment the manager signed, not a score.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report figure that has no ticket or ledger row.
Keep hiring, assignment, and access changes as their own decision.
role.ambitious_version: A signed priority list can open the week's work board, and the manager still releases it.
